description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git diff' command with a focus on submodule difference options and behaviors. It contains setup commands, functions, and various test cases for verifying submodule diff outputs in different scenarios, including encoding, modifications, deletions, and nested submodules.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a given directory, commits the changes with specific encoding and message, and returns the short commit hash.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message, used to finalize changes in tests.
